title: "Fecal weight analysis"
author: "Amelia Slusser"
date: "2026-07-30"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
```

Prepare and plot data (male)
```{r}
# Read data
fecal <- data.frame(
  Week = c("W1","W1","W2","W2","W2","W3","W3","W3",
           "W4","W4","W4","W5","W5","W5","W6","W6","W6"),
  Control_m_1 = c(356,237.7,451.8,59,363.1,394.8,332.3,284.8,
                  372.5,371.7,370.9,205.5,231.6,399.6,457.9,228.3,610.1),
  Control_m_2 = c(386.5,220.1,378.4,181,358.1,442.1,363.7,276,
                  439.1,220.9,439.6,413.7,293.9,280,250.9,245.9,139.4),
  Stress_m_1 = c(268.4,391,173.1,141.8,268.8,413.7,284.2,330.2,
                 382.3,198.4,435.1,580.3,309.6,357.9,423.4,224.4,338.8),
  Stress_m_2 = c(372.1,324.8,526.9,471.3,432.1,501.4,453.4,446.3,
                 435.7,263.9,596.9,472.6,334.4,365,530,358.3,436.2)
)

# Convert to long format
fecal_long <- fecal %>%
  pivot_longer(-Week,
               names_to = "Sample",
               values_to = "Weight") %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Control", Sample), "Control", "Stress"))

# Order weeks
fecal_long$Week <- factor(fecal_long$Week,
                          levels = c("W1","W2","W3","W4","W5","W6"))

# Calculate summary statistics
summary_df <- fecal_long %>%
  group_by(Week, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Weight),
    SD = sd(Weight),
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
male_plot <- ggplot(fecal_long,
       aes(x = Week, y = Weight, color = Group)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Group),
               fun = mean,
               geom = "line",
               linewidth = 1.2,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Group),
               fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Group),
               fun.data = mean_se,
               geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.15,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "#4D4D4D",
    "Stress" = "#FE8A13"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Fecal weight (mg)",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 25)
# Display plot
male_plot
```

Save
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "male_FecalWeight_byWeek.pdf",
  plot = male_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```

Prepare and plot data (female)
```{r}
# Read data
fecal <- data.frame(
  Week = c("W1","W1","W2","W2","W2","W3","W3","W3",
           "W4","W4","W4","W5","W5","W5","W6","W6","W6"),
  Control_f_1 = c(445.8,227,430.7,181.9,403,428.6,226,263.5,
                  367.5,470.8,526,427,196.8,223.2,353.5,231.2,198),
  Control_f_2 = c(196.8,283.6,266.9,267.3,228,593.7,456.1,244.8,
                  300.5,177,314.1,429.5,248.1,297.6,248.9,259,243.6),
  Stress_f_1 = c(165,344.7,160.4,334.8,189.8,401.7,247.6,359.8,
                 493.3,304.9,370.7,241.8,149.7,282.5,314.8,411.5,230.7),
  Stress_f_2 = c(213.2,82.2,232.4,102.1,224.6,383.3,216.9,220.2,
                 311.2,188.8,242.4,254.3,186.7,241.1,98.4,258.5,156.9)
)

# Convert to long format
fecal_long <- fecal %>%
  pivot_longer(-Week,
               names_to = "Sample",
               values_to = "Weight") %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Control", Sample), "Control", "Stress"))

# Order weeks
fecal_long$Week <- factor(
  fecal_long$Week,
  levels = c("W1","W2","W3","W4","W5","W6")
)

# Plot
female_plot <- ggplot(fecal_long,
                      aes(x = Week, y = Weight, color = Group)) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Group),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.20)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Group),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.20)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Group),
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.20)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "#4D4D4D",
    "Stress" = "#FE8A13"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Fecal weight (mg)",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 25)

# Display plot
female_plot
```

Save
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "female_FecalWeight_byWeek.pdf",
```
